task: pool.ObjectPool<T>: bounded blocking object pool with lazy creation, validation, invalidate, close and slot-safe failure handling
reasoning_summary: A single ReentrantLock with a slot-free Condition guards idle/borrowed/total bookkeeping. A slot is reserved (total++) before the factory runs and returned on failure, and all user callbacks (factory, validator, destroyer) run outside the lock. Borrowed objects are tracked in an identity set so double or foreign releases are rejected. Tests cover each contract point plus a 12-thread stress test checking the max bound, no shared object and every created object destroyed exactly once.
